The '''Metharg system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with [[Metharg's University]].<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Metharg [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
